questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析及语境理解。作者回忆在乌干达西部的童年，提到生活充满了“和平与自由(peace and freedom)”，与后文难民营中“尘土飞扬、疲惫不堪”的复杂艰难生活形成鲜明对比，因此童年生活是“简单的、纯朴的(simple)”。balanced(平衡的)、creative(有创造力的)、harmonious(和谐的)虽为褒义，但simple最能与后文的沉重与反差相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(balanced): 语境句：A balanced diet is essential for your healthy physical development. 固定搭配：balanced diet, keep balanced
B(creative): 语境句：The teacher encouraged the students to think in a creative way. 固定搭配：creative thinking, highly creative
C(harmonious): 语境句：We are making efforts to build a harmonious society. 固定搭配：harmonious relationship, live in a harmonious environment
D(simple): 语境句：He prefers a simple life in the countryside to a busy city life. 固定搭配：simple life, pure and simple

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。父亲是一个善良的人，他教导作者与周围人融洽相处的“价值/重要性(value)”。taught me the value of doing sth意为“教导我做某事的价值/意义”。mystery(谜)、definition(定义)、process(过程)均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(mystery): 语境句：The origin of the universe remains a mystery to scientists. 固定搭配：solve a mystery, remain a mystery
B(value): 语境句：Volunteering helps teenagers realize the true value of helping others. 固定搭配：core value, value of life
C(definition): 语境句：By definition, a volunteer is someone who works without being paid. 固定搭配：by definition, clear definition
D(process): 语境句：Learning a foreign language is a slow and gradual process. 固定搭配：in the process of, learning process

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据后文的“Walking through... observing how people lived”可知，朋友邀请作者去“参观/走访(tour)”难民营。support(支持)、inspect(视察、检查)、invest(投资)均不符合作为普通访客的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(support): 语境句：We should support local businesses to boost the economy. 固定搭配：support oneself, in support of
B(inspect): 语境句：The official arrived to inspect the safety of the new building. 固定搭配：inspect closely, inspect the damage
C(invest): 语境句：The government decided to invest more money in public education. 固定搭配：invest in, invest time and energy
D(tour): 语境句：We hired a guide to tour the ancient city during the holiday. 固定搭配：tour a place, on tour

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。作者看到难民营里孩子们在泥土里玩耍，大人们眼神低垂，生活条件艰苦，因此内心感到“心碎的(heartbroken)”。helpless(无助的)、confused(困惑的)、troubled(苦恼的)情感深度不如heartbroken贴切，且heartbroken最能引出后文他想要提供帮助的决心。
questions.supplement:
A(helpless): 语境句：When the fire broke out, the villagers felt completely helpless. 固定搭配：feel helpless, helpless victim
B(confused): 语境句：I was a bit confused by the complicated instructions. 固定搭配：be confused about, look confused
C(troubled): 语境句：The troubled boy finally opened up to his psychology teacher. 固定搭配：troubled times, deeply troubled
D(heartbroken): 语境句：She was entirely heartbroken when her beloved pet passed away. 固定搭配：feel heartbroken, completely heartbroken

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。根据前文“eyes cast low(眼神低垂)”以及后文“as the sky was windy black(像狂风大作的黑天一样)”的隐喻，可知老年人们显得十分“沮丧的、抑郁的(depressed)”。bored(无聊的)、lonely(孤独的)、frightening(令人害怕的)均不符合此处沉重悲凉的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(bored): 语境句：The students got bored with the endless repetitive exercises. 固定搭配：be bored to death, get bored with
B(depressed): 语境句：He felt depressed after failing the important exam. 固定搭配：feel depressed, severely depressed
C(lonely): 语境句：Living alone in a foreign country, she often feels lonely. 固定搭配：feel lonely, a lonely journey
D(frightening): 语境句：It was a frightening experience to be trapped in the elevator. 固定搭配：frightening experience, frighteningly close

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。“flashed through my mind(在脑海中闪过)”通常搭配画面或影像。难民营白天见到的“画面/影像(images)”在夜晚如风般在作者脑海中不断闪现。thoughts(想法)、reflections(倒影/沉思)、shadows(影子)不如images具有画面感和视觉冲击力。
questions.supplement:
A(images): 语境句：Vivid images of his childhood flashed through his mind. 固定搭配：mental image, vivid images
B(thoughts): 语境句：She sat in silence, lost in her own deep thoughts. 固定搭配：lost in thought, second thoughts
C(reflections): 语境句：He looked at his own reflections in the calm water. 固定搭配：upon reflection, daily reflections
D(shadows): 语境句：The trees cast long shadows on the grass in the evening. 固定搭配：in the shadows, cast a shadow

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。作者的童年是充满和平与自由的(peace and freedom)，而难民营的家庭则生活在泥土和疲惫中，这两者之间形成了鲜明的“对比(contrast)”。connection(联系)、similarity(相似性)、unity(团结)均与语意相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(connection): 语境句：There is a close connection between diet and physical health. 固定搭配：make a connection, in connection with
B(similarity): 语境句：Despite their different backgrounds, there is a striking similarity between them. 固定搭配：bear a similarity to, striking similarity
C(contrast): 语境句：The sharp contrast between the rich and the poor was striking. 固定搭配：by contrast, sharp contrast
D(unity): 语境句：National unity is essential for the rapid development of a country. 固定搭配：in unity, sense of unity

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。这种鲜明的对比深深地“打动/触动(moved)”了作者，导致他内心产生一种冲动(a gentle pull in my heart)。pushed(推)、shaped(塑造)、burned(燃烧)不符合“触动内心”的表达习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(pushed): 语境句：The challenging environment pushed him to work even harder. 固定搭配：push forward, push sb to do sth
B(shaped): 语境句：His early experiences in the countryside shaped his character. 固定搭配：shape the future, shape one's character
C(burned): 语境句：The ancient building was burned to the ground last night. 固定搭配：burn down, burn out
D(moved): 语境句：We were deeply moved by his inspiring speech. 固定搭配：be deeply moved, move to tears

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。风曾经是穿过香蕉叶的顽皮低语，现在却承载着尘土飞扬的“绝望(desperation)”。结合前文难民的生活状态(疲惫、低垂的眼睛)，此处表达环境带给人的绝望感。guilt(内疚)、regret(后悔)、anger(愤怒)均不符合难民营整体展现出的低沉与无力感。
questions.supplement:
A(desperation): 语境句：In a moment of desperation, he sold his favorite car. 固定搭配：in desperation, feeling of desperation
B(guilt): 语境句：He was consumed by a deep sense of guilt for his mistake. 固定搭配：sense of guilt, admit guilt
C(regret): 语境句：Much to my regret, I couldn't attend her graduation ceremony. 固定搭配：express regret, much to one's regret
D(anger): 语境句：She tried hard to control her anger when facing the unfair treatment. 固定搭配：in anger, out of anger

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。内心的触动让作者的目标之种“真正地(truly)”扎了根。truly强调真实地、彻底地发生；suddenly(突然)、carefully(小心地)、constantly(不断地)均不贴切。这里强调内心的使命感变得坚定和确凿。
questions.supplement:
A(truly): 语境句：I am truly grateful for all the help you have given me. 固定搭配：yours truly, truly believe
B(suddenly): 语境句：The sky suddenly turned dark, and heavy rain poured down. 固定搭配：stop suddenly, suddenly realize
C(carefully): 语境句：Please read the instructions carefully before using the machine. 固定搭配：listen carefully, carefully designed
D(constantly): 语境句：The English language is constantly changing and evolving over time. 固定搭配：constantly change, constantly remind

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。目标扎根后，作者准备好去响应这种“召唤(call)”。answer the call是固定搭配，意为“响应号召，回应内心的呼唤”。challenge(挑战)、question(问题)、demand(要求)均不符合此处的语境搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(challenge): 语境句：Learning to play the piano was a huge challenge for him. 固定搭配：face a challenge, overcome a challenge
B(call): 语境句：Many young doctors answered the call to work in rural areas. 固定搭配：answer the call, a close call
C(question): 语境句：The reporter asked the president a very sharp question. 固定搭配：out of the question, beyond question
D(demand): 语境句：The workers' demand for higher pay was finally met. 固定搭配：meet the demand, in high demand

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。第二天作者回到难民营，开始在各个领域“做志愿服务(volunteering)”，结合后文“a whole team of dedicated volunteers”可知，他最初就是去当志愿者的。organizing(组织)、advocating(提倡)、evaluating(评估)不如volunteering贴合语境中的具体行动色彩。
questions.supplement:
A(organizing): 语境句：She is busy organizing a charity event to help disabled children. 固定搭配：organizing committee, organizing capacity
B(advocating): 语境句：The group is advocating for better environmental protection laws. 固定搭配：advocate for, strongly advocate
C(evaluating): 语境句：Teachers are evaluating the students' performance at the end of the term. 固定搭配：evaluate performance, evaluate the impact
D(volunteering): 语境句：Volunteering in the local hospital taught her the value of compassion. 固定搭配：volunteer to do sth, volunteer for

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。从作者一个人的努力，到五年内发展成一整个志愿者团队，这说明作者在慢慢“扩大(expanded)”他的努力/事业规模。adjusted(调整)、complicated(使复杂化)、varied(使多样化)均不能体现规模从小变大的过程。
questions.supplement:
A(adjusted): 语境句：He quickly adjusted his plan to suit the changing weather conditions. 固定搭配：adjust to, adjust one's strategy
B(complicated): 语境句：The sudden arrival of the guests complicated the whole situation. 固定搭配：complicated issue, highly complicated
C(expanded): 语境句：The small business expanded into a large international company. 固定搭配：expand the market, expand one's horizons
D(varied): 语境句：The school offers a varied program of cultural and sports activities. 固定搭配：varied interests, rich and varied

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。微小的目标“种子(seed)”经过五年时间，“成长为(grown into)”了一整个充满奉献精神的志愿者团队。符合比喻逻辑。broken into(破门而入/闯入)、transformed into(转变成，虽可通但grown与seed呼应更完美)、fallen into(养成/落入)。
questions.supplement:
A(grown into): 语境句：The small seed has grown into a magnificent oak tree. 固定搭配：grow into, grow up
B(broken into): 语境句：The house was broken into while the family was on vacation. 固定搭配：break into tears, break into a house
C(transformed into): 语境句：The old factory was transformed into a modern art museum. 固定搭配：transform A into B, completely transformed
D(fallen into): 语境句：He has fallen into the bad habit of staying up late. 固定搭配：fall into a habit, fall into sleep

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。后文提到“In unity, there is strength(团结就是力量)”，结合“together we stand(我们站在一起)”，可知他们是被一种信念“团结(united)”在一起。changed(改变)、influenced(影响)、comforted(安慰)均不能体现出团队的凝聚力。
questions.supplement:
A(changed): 语境句：Technology has changed the way we communicate with each other. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better
B(influenced): 语境句：His writing style was deeply influenced by classical literature. 固定搭配：be influenced by, profoundly influenced
C(united): 语境句：The nation stood united in the face of the terrible natural disaster. 固定搭配：united as one, stay united
D(comforted): 语境句：The crying child was comforted by his mother's gentle voice. 固定搭配：feel comforted, be comforted by

section_2_word_form.passage:
Dishes in Chinese food culture have their origins. For example, “Dongpo Pork”. After Su Shi was downgraded, he came to Hangzhou organizing migrant workers to dredge(疏浚) the West Lake, build bridges, [56] transform the old West Lake into a new look. People there were very grateful to Su Shi for [57] he had done. It was heard that he liked pork best, so everyone would carry meat and wine to him to pay a New Year greeting. After [58] (receive) it, Su Shi instructed his family to cut the meat into cubes, burned it red and crisp, and then [59] (distribute) it to the migrant workers participating in the dredging of the West Lake to eat. People warmly called the meat “Dongpo Pork” because of Su Shi's name.
In the West, there's also a story behind the origin of food. For example, pizza and the story of Queen Margherita. Thin, round bread [60] (use) in the cooking of Egyptians, Etruscans and Romans long ago. It was eaten at the end of every meal during the Renaissance [61] a dish for the poor and enriched by the arrival of various [62] (tomato) from America in the 18th century: it was then that it began to gain the appreciation of the [63] (wealth) classes. Another important date in the pizza story is 1899 when Queen Margherita of Savoy made the famous Neapolitan pizza maker Raffaele Esposito [64] (prepare) a pizza in three colors, symbolizing the Italian flag. The Pizza was named “Pizza Margherita”. Since then, pizza [65] (take) the world by storm.

questions.explanation: 本题考查连词。分析句子结构，dredge, build和transform三个动词原形作宾语补足语，属于平行并列结构（organize sb to do A, do B, and do C），因此在最后一个动词前需要填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He enjoys reading books, listening to music, and playing basketball. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。相关考点：在列举多个并列成分时，最后两个成分之间用and连接，前面共用to。

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词性从句。介词for后接宾语从句。在从句“_ he had done”中，done缺少宾语，且表示“他所做的事情”，故填入what引导该宾语从句并在从句中作宾语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：I am totally responsible for what I have said. 固定搭配：what to do, what's more。相关考点：what在名词性从句中必须充当主语、宾语或表语，相当于the thing(s) that。

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。After在此处作介词，后接动词时需使用动名词(V-ing)形式作介词的宾语，且主语Su Shi与receive是主动关系，故填receiving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(receiving)：语境句：After receiving the letter, she immediately burst into tears. 固定搭配：look forward to receiving, upon receiving。原词receive其它变形：receiver(n. 接收者/听筒), receipt(n. 收据/收到)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态与并列结构。此处与前面的instructed和burned构成连续动作的并列谓语，句子整体是一般过去时，因此填动词过去式distributed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(distributed)：语境句：The charity distributed food and clothes to the earthquake victims. 固定搭配：distribute to, widely distributed。原词distribute其它变形：distribution(n. 分发/分布), distributor(n. 经销商)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词的时态和语态。主语Thin, round bread与use之间是被动关系（面包被使用）；时间状语是long ago，表示发生在过去的事情，故用一般过去时的被动语态。bread为不可数名词，谓语动词用单数，填was used。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was used)：语境句：This ancient tool was used for hunting thousands of years ago. 固定搭配：be used for doing sth, be used to do sth。原词use其它变形：useful(adj. 有用的), useless(adj. 无用的), usage(n. 使用/用法)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词。be eaten as...意为“作为……被吃”。as此处作介词，意为“作为”，符合句意“在文艺复兴时期它作为穷人的菜肴被食用”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as)：语境句：He worked as an assistant manager for three years. 固定搭配：act as, serve as, regard... as。相关考点：as作介词常表示身份、用途或角色。

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词复数。根据前面的various (各种各样的)可知，此处需用名词复数形式。tomato以o结尾，其复数形式一般加-es，故填tomatoes。
questions.supplement: 正确形(tomatoes)：语境句：The farmer harvested a large basket of fresh tomatoes. 固定搭配：cherry tomatoes, tomato paste。相关考点：以o结尾加es的常见名词有：hero, potato, tomato, Negro (口诀：黑人英雄爱吃土豆西红柿)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。空处修饰名词classes(阶级)，需用形容词形式。wealth是名词，其形容词形式为wealthy(富有的)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(wealthy)：语境句：The wealthy businessman donated a lot of money to the local school. 固定搭配：wealthy family, the wealthy (富人)。原词wealth其它变形：wealth(n. 财富), wealthily(adv. 富有地)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。此处是make sb. do sth.结构，即使役动词make后跟不带to的不定式作宾语补足语，故填动词原形prepare。
questions.supplement: 正确形(prepare)：语境句：The teacher made the students prepare for the upcoming debate. 固定搭配：make sb do sth, prepare for, prepare to do。原词prepare其它变形：preparation(n. 准备), prepared(adj. 准备好的)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态。句首有时间状语Since then (从那时起)，它通常与现在完成时连用。主语pizza是单数，故填has taken。take the world by storm是固定表达，意为“风靡世界”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(has taken)：语境句：Since its release, the new video game has taken the market by storm. 固定搭配：take... by storm, take action。原词take其它变形：took(过去式), taken(过去分词), taking(现在分词)。
